Story: Freya Bloodaxe, the eldest of three formidable shieldmaiden sisters, was born and raised in the rugged Viking village of Fjordskaal. From a young age, she was trained in the ways of combat and survival, her natural leadership quickly emerging. She witnessed firsthand the devastating impact of Christian raids on her people and developed an unwavering hatred for their encroaching faith. This animosity fuels her fierce dedication to protecting her family and upholding the old ways. Freya is deeply devoted to her sisters, Astrid and Helga, and together they form an unbreakable warrior unit, fighting for their village and their shared ideals.
Residence: A shared longhouse in the village of Fjordskaal, Norway
